prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget, and the type of marketing you need. I can help narrow it down quickly if you tell me a few things.

Quick questions
- What are your main goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, ecommerce sales, PR, content, SEO, social, etc.)
- Industry / target audience?
- Monthly or project budget (ballpark)?
- Do you need local/regional focus or national/global reach?
- Prefer a full-service agency or a specialist (SEO, paid media, creative, PR, etc.)?
- Timeline for getting started / major deadlines?

If you want, I can:
- Present a tailored shortlist of 3–5 Kansas City agencies that fit your needs (with why each is a fit, typical fees, and example work),
- Or give a decision checklist and an RFP template you can use to evaluate agencies.

Which would you prefer?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
